description: DOWN TO ONE RESIDUAL (verified HEAD d42413dfa). The two-part fix largely landed via concurrent work: (1) addressed-alpha convergence_class LANDED (dc6e737e2, convergence_class_at); the frontier-consistency concern (14.10.3) is MOOT (realpha removed). What remains is the transport-shape residual: SealSemanticClosure seals fine, but the transport plan-builder's component_shapes agree-or-panic meet (transport.rs:338) rejects FunctionId(68) — four EVIDENCE-DISTINCT executables (inputs [Ty32,Ty93], [Ty32,Ty322], [Ty32,Ty347], [Ty32,Ty998]) carry four distinct ShapeIds (32/33/34/35) inside ONE union-find connected component. Two coupled defects: (a) DETERMINISM — component_shapes is HashMap-iteration-order-dependent, so which ShapeId 'wins' the flat meet varies -> the panic is FLAKY under parallelism (the 2 HEAD reds enum_reduce_runtime_graph + take_positive_reduce_while flip pass/fail); (b) REAL — four genuinely-distinct-shaped producers should not be forced to one shape at a converged-activation input position (the [[shapeid_is_pure_layout]] multi-producer case 14.7.2 fixed for callables, here for input shapes). Fix (b) (don't fuse distinct-shape producers; box/widen or keep per-producer positions) + (a) (deterministic component shaping). This is the last piece of the convergence epic.

comments.text: transport.rs:338 residual — HOW the order causes it, PROVEN (spike ad3e97b, pass-vs-panic rendered). NON-MONOTONE graph construction. FunctionId(68) value3 has FOUR genuinely-distinct Callable layouts (capture_shapes [15]/[16]/[17]/[28] -> ShapeIds 32/33/34/35; structurally identical across runs — NOT order-variant internings). PASS run: 4 distinct union-find roots (separate components, meet consistent). PANIC run: 1 shared root (fused, agree-or-panic fires). The chain: (1) collect_executable_input_constraints decides anchor-own vs equal-union per input position, gated by STATEFUL accumulator anchored_function_inputs keyed (function, semantic_index) — NOT including evidence types — so the first-visited specialization sets the flag and forces layout-distinct siblings down a different branch; (2) visitation = executables.sort_by_key(executable_sort_key) where executable_sort_key = (function, activation.inputs() Vec<Ty>, need), and Vec<Ty> sorts on RAW interned Ty id (Ty(u32) Ord); (3) those ids are minted by the upstream type fixpoint in PROCESS-HASH-DEPENDENT order (Ty93/322/349/1005 vs Ty93/324/347/998 — same logical types, diff ids). Volatile ids -> volatile sort -> volatile first-visited -> volatile gate sequence -> the union-ladder's 'canonical executable-sort order' assumption is VIOLATED -> non-monotone graph -> flaky panic. The agree-or-panic meet (transport.rs:338) is the CORRECT invariant; the bug is the non-canonical input feeding it. FIX (two coupled): (1) executable_sort_key must sort on an ORDER-STABLE structural/canonical projection of inputs, not raw Ty id; (2) the anchor-vs-union decision must be a PURE per-position function (>=2 layout-distinct resolved surfaces converging on one input -> all anchor own shape, never union) not a stateful (function, semantic_index) accumulator. (1) restores schedule-independence; (2) guarantees correctness (distinct layouts never fused). This is the last piece — the 2 HEAD reds (enum_reduce_runtime_graph, take_positive_reduce_while) are this.
